sources.title: Federal Reserve Board - Foreign Exchange Rates - H.10 - November 09, 2026
sources.paraphrase: Daily bilateral exchange-rate observations for the previous business week are released on Monday at 16:15 ET, or the next business day if Monday is a Federal Holiday. Weekly H.10 publication was suspended May 22, 2006 through January 2009; historical observations remain downloadable.

sources.title: South Korean Won to U.S. Dollar Spot Exchange Rate (DEXKOUS)
sources.meaning: The noon-New-York date is an observation date. The H.10/FRED publication is later; the daily observation date cannot stand in for availability.

concreteCounterexample.conclusion: The KRW NAV assigned to Oct30 incorporates a future observation published later still. These results may describe an ex-post asynchronous currency translation but cannot support contemporaneous/PIT/no-look-ahead KRW NAV. FX is not a strategy signal in STATE_COLS; this defect does not change the USD results.
